reason: I walk 20 minutes to school and that's fine, so I don't really need a bike in Schleswig. And to even start I'd have to get my parents to put their card in the app, which is annoying for something I'd use maybe twice.
objection: With only 10 bikes in town there probably won't be one near me when I actually want it, and I'd have to bug my parents to set up the payment first.
would_change_my_mind: If I could pay myself without my parents (like PayPal, a prepaid card or a school pass) and there was always a bike at my school or the station.
